【原视频简介】
Bonjour friends,  

How have you been? 

The weather has been colder lately and the rain is coming back. I'm so so happy about it. The garden is like me; it's feeling alive again. 

I picked my first tomatoes of the season; I think I'm going to have a lot more soon. The peach trees were overflowing with fruits, so I harvested them and baked a really simple but delicious upside down cake with it. I enjoyed it outside with vanilla ice cream. It was delicious. 

The recipe is down below if you want to try it. 🤗

Hope you will have a great day. 

Thank you so much for watching this video and for your support. ❤️

Take care friends, see you soon  

🏡🌧️

🍑☀️ Upside down peach cake 🍑☀️

Peaches ( Enough to cover the bottom of your pan, I used around 6 of them)

For the batter :

150G Sugar 
150 Soft butter 
3 eggs 
150g Flour 
10g Baking powder 
A pinch of salt

For the caramel : 
100g Sugar 

- Preheat your oven to 180°C 
- In a big bowl mix together the soft butter and sugar until fully combined.
- Add the eggs one by one, until you obtain a homogeneous batter. 
- Add the flour, baking powder and salt. Mix together until smooth and set aside. 
- Put the leftover sugar in a pan and heat it gently while stirring until it forms a caramel, don't overcook it or it will be bitter. 
- Pour the caramel in the bottom of your buttered and floured pan and add the peaches cut in halves.
